acceptance: PROVISIONAL; local numerical RMS pass only; most of sheet unvalidated; not geographically or user accepted
limitations: Four excluded checks give RMS 41.42 m, median 25.59 m, P95 66.37 m and maximum 73.22 m, but this is sparse local evidence only.
Only three control ponds and four checks are supported in a narrow northeastern cluster. Three checks share control ponds; the fourth is a nearby separate pond.
Most of the sheet, including western and central interior, southern areas, estuaries and the entire coast, remains unvalidated. Whole-sheet geographic adequacy is not established.
A constrained similarity was chosen before scoring to avoid unsupported affine shear. Extrapolation beyond the small control region is weakly supported.
Natural shorelines use 12 px working source uncertainty.
